clear.description: When true, empty the tray before recording a selection. With no other fields, this only empties the tray.

object.description: Source, page, artifact or task id the user pointed at.

anchor.description: Anchor inside the object, such as #L14-20 or #t=00:12:31-00:13:05. Null selects the whole object.

quote.description: Quoted text. Stored and returned only when sensitivity is normal; a private object stores no quote.

quote_sha256.description: Hash of the object at selection time. Omitted on a normal quote, the quote's SHA-256 is stored. Never stored for a private object.

view.description: The view the user was looking at. Required when object is set.

sensitivity.description: How far the quote may travel. Defaults to normal. private stores the reference only.
